units.title: Introduction to Microbiology
topics:  History and scope of microbiology  Importance of microorganisms in food
industry, and environment  Classification and types of microorganisms

units.title: Microbial Cell Structure and Function
topics:  Types of microorganisms associated with food  Structure of bacteria
fungi
yeasts, and viruses  Significance of spores in food microbiology

units.title: Microbial Growth and Control
topics:  Microbial growth and reproduction
Growth curve of bacteria (lag, log, stationary
death phase)  Factors affecting microbial growth (temperature, pH, water activity)  Physical and chemical methods for microbial control

units.title: Microbiology of Food and Fermentation
topics:  Common foodborne pathogens and spoilage microorganisms  Fermentation and role of microbes in food production  Beneficial microbes in dairy
beverages, and probiotics

units.title: Food Spoilage and Preservation
topics:  Microbial spoilage of different food products (meat
dairy
fruits
vegetables etc.)  Principles of food preservation (thermal
chemical

biological methods etc.)  Role of preservatives and hurdle technology Program Name: Bachelor of Engineering Level: UG Branch: Food Engineering & Technology Subject Code : BE03051011 Subject Name : Basic Microbiology

units.title: Foodborne Diseases and Safety
topics:  Common foodborne pathogens (Salmonella
E. coli
Listeria
etc.)  Food intoxications vs. food infections  HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point) and food safety regulations

units.title: Microbial Analysis of Food
topics:  Sampling and microbiological examination of food  Standard plate count
coliform test, and other microbial assays  Rapid detection methods for foodborne pathogens

units.title: Industrial and Environmental Microbiology
topics:  Role of microorganisms in biotechnology and waste treatment  Microbial enzymes in food processing  Bioremediation and probiotics

units.title: Emerging Trends in Food Microbiology
topics:  Genetically modified microorganisms (GMOs) in food  Application of metagenomics in food safety  Role of AI and automation in food microbiology
